notes.title: Card'em All! Demo is now out!
notes.content:
[h1]The Demo for [i]Card'em All![/i] is now available![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504989/bf55ef28b3fe3d40cc34057800d339e7e2f46042.gif[/img]

I am pleased to announce that the  [i]Card'em All![/i] Demo is finally out, offering a taste of this new adventure.  Trapped in deep torpor, you do through sequences of dreams, fighting enemies, real and imaginary, on a quest to find out who you are and to eventually wake up.

As you defeat enemies, you will have the opportunity to incorporate them as new cards in your deck, giving access to more strategies. All enemies, excerpt for certain bosses can become cards. The plan for the full version is to include the bosses as well, subject to certain limitations.

The demo includes the first three timelines of the game, each comprising ten encounters.  If you die, on purpose or in battle, your dream starts over, with you keeping your earned deck and half of the gold. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504989/7d0d822f85fd3db27f5bdf94e5ca4c4bbb29ad11.gif[/img]

This game has a unique deck management system, which is for the player to discover and optimize.

Have fun!
